decision: Behavioral reimplementation with complete traceability; no SKKF code/config/SQL/formula/asset reuse
Five sessions are source accountability tracks, not five target microservices
HRM owns canonical people/employment/assignment/org in dwp-people-server
PER starts as an extraction-ready bounded context in dwp-people-server/hris/performance
TIM is implemented in a new dwp-time-server
PAY is implemented in a new dwp-payroll-server with country/provider ports
SYS behavior extends DWP Auth/Platform/Gateway/Audit; dwp-sys-server is forbidden
Each service owns its database schema; cross-service FK/join/repository access is forbidden
Internal tenant and local keys follow BIGINT DWP conventions; public aggregate identifiers are UUID
Published business validity uses half-open [from,to) intervals with overlap prevention
Time, leave, payroll and external side-effect records are append-only with correction/reversal lineage
change_trigger: Legal retention or ledger model change

decision: High-impact commands require idempotency, payload hash, CAS and durable receipt
Service propagation uses transactional outbox and idempotent inbox; no distributed transaction
DWP HRIS app entitlement is the parent gate; leaf access is atomic capability plus scope/field/SoD
Static SoD is Auth-owned; object/state dynamic SoD is owner-service enforced
Variation order is Product Core then Country Pack then Tenant Config then Signed Extension Pack
Configuration is immutable-versioned and follows draft/validate/simulate/approve/publish/rollback
Batch control is centralized in DWP Platform and executes allowlisted domain commands via signed manifests
Connector control is centralized; transport, mapping and domain command adapters are separated
HRIS home is a role/scope-aware widget read model and never a menu catalog
The full capability catalog belongs to governed /hr/explore; leaf flows stay inside workspaces
HRIS features use public feature APIs and central generated contracts; sibling implementation imports are forbidden
Gateway routes external APIs but owner services retain business authorization and state decisions
Synthetic golden packs unblock generic-core code; real customer and statutory goldens gate activation
Rates/forms/rounding are effective-dated signed country-pack content, never generic-core constants
SKKF migration is canonical extract/transform/reconcile/cutover, not schema cloning
Sensitive identifiers and payment destinations are tokenized/restricted; logs/events expose no raw values
AI may explain/draft/classify but cannot autonomously decide employment/pay/attendance/performance or publish policy
Functional G4 precedes Design AI G5A/B/C; visual replacement cannot alter functional contracts silently
External connectors, country law, customer data/load and named production approvals are G6 activation gates, not generic-core code blockers

Employee listening and people analytics stay in dwp-platform-server only as the isolated hrisinsights bounded context and hris_insights schema/role; they may perform privacy aggregation but never employment/time/payroll/performance decisions
change_trigger: Approved insight-context extraction to People or a dedicated service

decision: Physical owner prefixes are fixed to ppl/prf/tme/abs/pay/sys_product_access/com_product_access/sys_hris with runtime schema and file scope; legacy design-only hr/tim/hrx names are forbidden

All HRIS numeric values use named decimal types and an explicit source-normalize/formula/element/worker-result/settlement pipeline; wire floats database rounding hardcoded minor units and silent overflow are forbidden
